content:
Mommy. I don't feel good.
What's wrong, Joseph?
My stomach hurts.
Oh no. Let me get some medicine.
Okay, mommy.
Here, Joseph. Drink this.
Thank you, mom.
I'll call the school. Try to rest, dear.
